title: Khao Soi Kai (Northern Thai Coconut Curry Noodle Soup with Chicken)
description: Khao Soi Kai is a signature dish of Northern Thai cuisine, featuring tender chicken simmered in a rich coconut curry broth served over soft egg noodles. Finished with crispy fried noodles, pickled mustard greens, fresh herbs, and lime, this dish combines creamy, spicy, tangy, and crunchy elements into a perfectly balanced bowl of Thai comfort food.

ingredients.title: For the Curry Paste
items: Dried red chilies – 6, soaked in warm water and deseeded
Galangal – 1 thumb-sized piece (or ginger if unavailable)
Lemongrass – 1 stalk, tender inner part finely sliced

ingredients.title: For the Coconut Curry Soup
items: Chicken drumsticks or thighs – 500 g, bone-in
Palm sugar or brown sugar – 2 tbsp
Salt – ½ tsp or to taste

ingredients.title: For Noodles & Garnish
items: Vegetable oil – for deep-frying crispy noodle garnish
Chili oil – optional, for extra heat

instruction.title: Step 1 – Preparing the Curry Paste
steps: Toast coriander seeds and cumin seeds until fragrant.
Blend or pound all curry paste ingredients together until a smooth, aromatic paste forms.
For traditional flavor, use a mortar and pestle to release maximum fragrance from the spices.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Frying the Paste & Cooking Chicken
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a heavy pot or wok over medium heat.
Add curry paste and fry for 3–5 minutes until fragrant and the oil begins to separate.
Add half of the coconut milk and cook until the mixture becomes glossy.
Add chicken pieces and coat thoroughly with the curry paste.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Building the Coconut Curry Broth
steps: Pour in the remaining coconut milk and chicken stock.
Add palm sugar, fish sauce, soy sauce, and salt.
Simmer gently for 25–30 minutes until the chicken becomes tender and the broth develops rich curry flavor.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Preparing the Egg Noodles
steps: Cook fresh egg noodles in boiling water until just tender, then drain well.
Reserve a small handful of noodles for frying.
Deep-fry reserved noodles until golden and crispy.
Drain on paper towels and keep aside for topping.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Assembling the Khao Soi
steps: Divide cooked egg noodles into serving bowls.
Ladle the hot coconut curry soup and chicken over the noodles.
Garnish with sliced red onion, pickled mustard greens, coriander, and lime wedges.
Finish with chili oil if extra spice is desired.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot in wide bowls to showcase the layered noodles, curry broth, and garnishes.
Add lime juice at the table to brighten the rich coconut curry flavors.
Pair with extra pickled mustard greens and chili oil for a traditional Northern Thai experience.

chefTips: The curry paste must be fried properly until aromatic and the oil separates — this creates the foundation of authentic Khao Soi flavor.
Balance the broth carefully: fish sauce adds depth, palm sugar rounds the spice, coconut milk provides richness, and lime adds freshness.
Fry crispy noodles in small batches to maintain a light, crunchy texture.
Bone-in chicken creates a deeper, more flavorful broth compared with boneless meat.
For restaurant-style presentation, arrange noodles neatly and layer garnishes instead of mixing everything together.
